 Jason Derulo to headline Qatar Grand Prix Sunday
 The pop star plays Lusail Live on 29 November, and every three-day ticket, from QAR 600, includes the show.
 Tbreak Editor 
 Nov 17, 2026 
 Key Takeaways
 Jason Derulo plays the Lusail Live stage on Sunday, 29 November 2026, during the Qatar Grand Prix weekend
 Every three-day ticket includes the concert; General Admission at Lusail Hill costs QAR 600
 Lusail Hill Lounge and Novikov at Premiere Hospitality are sold out; the Champions Club remains
 The circuit has not given a performance length, start time or set list

 Jason Derulo will headline the Lusail Live stage on Sunday, 29 November 2026, the Sunday of the Qatar Grand Prix weekend at Lusail International Circuit.
 Every three-day ticket includes the Derulo show, from General Admission at Lusail Hill (QAR 600) up to the grandstands.
 Lusail International Circuit (LIC) made the announcement, and its event page has the weekend’s details. The race weekend runs from 27 to 29 November at the circuit, and the Grand Prix starts at 7pm local time on Sunday. Sunday opens with the FIA Formula 2 Feature Race and the Formula 1 Drivers’ Parade before the Grand Prix, and LIC doesn’t say where the concert falls in the day. It’s the penultimate round of the season, with 22 drivers from 11 teams. LIC hosted the first Qatar Grand Prix in 2021 and has a ten-year agreement to host the race through 2032.

 Ticket prices
 All prices are for three days, 27 to 29 November, and are in Qatari riyals.
 Ticket Price 
 General Admission, Lusail Hill QAR 600 
 Main Grandstand QAR 2,000 
 North Grandstand QAR 1,500 
 Turn 2 and Turn 16 Grandstands QAR 1,000 
 University students get 20% off, from QAR 480, and senior citizens aged 60 and over get 25% off, from QAR 750. Both need valid ID. Tickets are sold at tickets.lcsc.qa .
 Novikov at Premiere Hospitality and Lusail Hill Lounge are sold out. The F1 Experiences Champions Club remains available and includes access to the concert. LIC says tickets are selling fast.
 Who is Jason Derulo?
 Derulo has had Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 hits including “Whatcha Say” and “Savage Love”, has sold more than 250 million singles and has more than 300 million followers across platforms. “Mi Chico”, with Melody and DJ Goja, spent six weeks at No. 1 on Billboard’s US Afrobeats chart and passed 368 million streams. It also started a viral dance trend with more than 2 billion views. The track will appear on his album The Last Dance (Part 2), due in early 2027.
 LIC hasn’t given a performance length, start time or set list, so the show details here are the circuit’s own account.
 For a UAE comparison, Hans Zimmer and BREDx headline Abu Dhabi’s November 2026 shows .
